name: Ambenonium
aliases: Ambenonium base, ambenonium dichloride, Ambenonum, Mytelase
summary: Ambenonium (as ambenonium dichloride, trade name Mytelase) is a cholinesterase inhibitor used in the management of myasthenia gravis.

pharmacology.text: Ambenonium exerts its actions against myasthenia gravis by competitive reversible inhibition of acetylcholinesterase, the enzyme responsible for the hydrolysis of acetylcholine. Myasthenia gravis occurs when the body produces antibodies against acetylcholine receptors, and thus inhibits signal transmission across the neuromuscular junction. Ambenonium reversibly binds acetylcholinesterase, inactivates it and therefore increases levels of acetylcholine.

uses.text: Ambenonium is used to treat muscle weakness due to disease or defect of the neuromuscular junction (myasthenia gravis). Ambenonium was withdrawn from the market in the United States in 2010.

sideEffects.en: By raising acetylcholine levels it can cause stomach cramps, diarrhoea, excess saliva, sweating, slow heartbeat and muscle twitching. Too much causes a cholinergic crisis, with weakness and breathing failure, which is a medical emergency.
sideEffects.zh: 由於它提高乙醯膽鹼濃度，可能造成腹部痙攣、腹瀉、唾液增多、出汗、心跳變慢與肌肉抽動。過量會引發膽鹼性危機，出現無力與呼吸衰竭，屬於醫療緊急狀況。
sideEffects.zhHans: 由于它提高乙酰胆碱浓度，可能造成腹部痉挛、腹泻、唾液增多、出汗、心跳变慢与肌肉抽动。过量会引发胆碱性危机，出现无力与呼吸衰竭，属于医疗紧急状况。

fact.en: It carries two positive charges, which keep it out of the brain and confine its action to nerve and muscle junctions in the body. It was sold as Mytelase and withdrawn in the United States in 2010.
fact.zh: 它帶有兩個正電荷，因此無法進入大腦，作用侷限於體內的神經肌肉接合處。它曾以 Mytelase 之名販售，2010 年在美國下市。
fact.zhHans: 它带有两个正电荷，因此无法进入大脑，作用局限于体内的神经肌肉接合处。它曾以 Mytelase 之名贩售，2010 年在美国下市。
